% ---- forms
\cssec{Forms}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $\max c^{\top}x$, $Ax\le b$, $x\ge0$; standard: $\min c^{\top}x$, $Ax=b$, $x\ge0$.
  \item Row $\le$: $+s$; row $\ge$: $-s$; free $x=x^+-x^-$; $b_i<0$: row times $-1$; $\max c^{\top}x=-\min(-c^{\top}x)$.
  \item Outcomes: infeasible, unbounded, optimal.
\end{itemize}

% ---- basic
\cssec{Corners}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Basis: $m$ independent columns; $x_B=B^{-1}b$, others zero.
  \item Corner $\Leftrightarrow$ basic feasible solution, $x_B\ge0$.
  \item At most $\binom{n}{m}$ bases. An optimum, if any, is at a corner.
\end{itemize}

% ---- step
\cssec{Simplex step (max)}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Last row $z-c^{\top}x=0$; basis of slacks if $b\ge0$.
  \item Enter: $r_j<0$ (Dantzig: the most negative; Bland: smallest index). None: optimal.
  \item Leave: smallest $b_i/a_{ie}$ over $a_{ie}>0$. No positive entry: unbounded.
  \item Pivot: make the column a unit column, $z$-row included.
  \item Zero under a nonbasic variable: another optimum may exist.
\end{itemize}

% ---- phase
\cssec{Phase I}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Make $b\ge0$; rows without a basic variable get artificial $a_i\ge0$.
  \item Minimize $w=\sum a_i$; price out the basic $a_i$ first.
  \item $w^*>0$: infeasible. $w^*=0$: pivot out the $a_i$ left at zero, restore $z$, price out, go on.
\end{itemize}

% ---- dual
\cssec{Duality}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $\max c^{\top}x$, $Ax\le b$, $x\ge0$ $\leftrightarrow$ $\min b^{\top}y$, $A^{\top}y\ge c$, $y\ge0$.
  \item Row $=$ gives free $y_i$; free $x_j$ gives row $=$.
  \item Weak: $c^{\top}x\le b^{\top}y$. Strong: equal at the optimum.
  \item Unbounded primal $\Rightarrow$ infeasible dual.
  \item Slackness: $y_i(b-Ax)_i=0$, $x_j(A^{\top}y-c)_j=0$.
  \item $y^{\top}=c_B^{\top}B^{-1}$: the $z$-row under the slacks.
\end{itemize}

% ---- sens
\cssec{Sensitivity}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $\partial p^*/\partial b_i=y_i^*$ while the basis lasts; $p^*(b)$ is concave, piecewise linear.
  \item Range of $b_i$: $x_B+\delta B^{-1}e_i\ge0$; $B^{-1}e_i$ is the column of $s_i$.
  \item Range of $c_j$: keep the $z$-row nonnegative.
  \item Slack row: price zero, but it can still limit a range.
\end{itemize}

% ---- breaks
\cssec{Failures}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Degenerate: a basic variable is zero, a pivot may not move the point.
  \item Cycling: bases repeat. Bland's rule: smallest index in and out.
  \item Worst case $2^n$ corners (Klee–Minty); usually a few times $m$.
  \item \texttt{linprog}: status 2 infeasible, 3 unbounded; \texttt{ineqlin.marginals} are the prices of a min.
\end{itemize}

\end{multicols}
